_comment: CANONICAL signature test vectors for the /internal/scheduled/* routes.
Copied byte-identically into the novamerx-scheduled-tasks repository at
test/vectors/scheduled-signature.json, and both test suites iterate it. The scheduler signs with
WebCrypto and TPS verifies with node:crypto; they share no code and never will. A fixed
expectation is what stops them drifting, because it is an ABSOLUTE constant rather than a
comparison: change the algorithm, key handling, encoding or digest on either side and that
side's own CI fails, with the other repository absent.
Generated from TPS's own signInboundRequest - the verifier is the authority, not the scheduler's signer.
'empty' is a signed request with no body at all (the signature then covers zero bytes).
'verdicts-non-ascii' pins UTF-8 on both sides: a subcontractor's reply reaches an em dash, a
curly apostrophe and a pound sign on day one.
'verdicts-ascii' also pins hex padding: its digest begins 08, a byte below 0x10, so a naive toString(16) without padStart produces a 63-character signature and fails here.
